params.delta_definition: direct numpy sum over primes[N:2N] of p^(-sigma)*(cos(t log p) - i sin(t log p))
params.difference_convention: backward along k: g[k,d] = g[k,d-1] - g[k-1,d-1]

constants.t_zero_note: t=0 is included deliberately and first: the summand is real and non-oscillatory, the closest analogue to the dyadic difference table's own object, which has no t
constants.o10_note: O10 is a deliberate gap in the series and is not filled by this script
